id.name: ConNF.Path.coderiv_deriv'
id.content:
theorem Path.coderiv_deriv' (A : β ↝ γ) (h : β < α) (B : γ ↝ δ) :
    A ↗ h ⇘ B = A ⇘ B ↗ h := by
  induction B with
  | nil => rfl
  | sderiv ε ζ B h' ih =>
    rw [deriv_sderiv, ih]
    rfl
